title: Experience viewer options, version 1
description: What a data experience shows: its tabs (view blocks), texts and translations. One file per experience: packages/packages/experiences/<name>/src/<name>-viewer.json. See packages/schemas/README.md for the versioning rules.

version.description: Version of this format. Loaders declare the smallest version they support (loaderOptions.viewerVersion).

dataPortal.description: Link to the page where people download their data.

dataPortalHtml.description: HTML alternative to dataPortal, e.g. instructions for a mobile app.

dataPortalMessage.description: Additional HTML hints shown with the data portal.

icon.description: URL or path of an icon, typically the company logo.

url.description: Alternative URL for placeholder experiences without real content.

dataSamples.description: Sample exports people can try the experience with.

collaborator.description: Partner organisation shown with the experience.

viewBlocks.description: The tabs of the experience, in display order.

messages.description: Translations by language code. Experience-specific texts that override the monolingual fields above.

id.description: Stable identifier of the tab, unique within the experience. Translations and shared results refer to it.

files.description: File ids (keys of loaderOptions.files) this tab needs.

sql.description: Query run on the experience's SQLite database. Ignored when customPipeline is set.

customPipeline.description: Name of a pipeline exported by the experience's viewer-functions.ts, or a generic pipeline from data-experience.

postprocessor.description: Name of a postprocessor exported by the experience's viewer-functions.ts.

visualization.description: A Vue component under data-experience/src/components/chart/view/ (e.g. "ChartViewDashboard.vue"), a Kepler map ("/kepler..."), or an inline Vega specification.

vizProps.description: Properties passed to the visualization component.
Translated properties, deep-merged over the block's vizProps.
